subject: Timezone bridge workshop — Singapore on-site + virtual bridge
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: María Ramos <maria.ramos@alcyonhealth.com>, scheduling@alcyonhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Timezone bridge workshop — initial dates and asks

Hi María / Alcyon scheduling,

Thanks again for the run of interest — excited to get this on calendar. We want to run a two-day executive workshop in Singapore with a live virtual bridge for teams in Tokyo and Sydney. Proposed on-site dates: Oct 20–21, 2026, with an optional prep/rehearsal on Oct 19 (afternoon). Virtual-only fallback window: Oct 25–26 if headcount changes.

Before I lock room blocks and travel: can you confirm (a) the primary decision-makers who will attend onsite vs virtual, (b) any hard blackout dates, and (c) if Alcyon needs KMS/NDAs for demo data? For logistics we will:
- Hold a tentative venue block in central Singapore (details attached)
- Schedule a 30-minute AV dry-run with your IT on Oct 19
- Propose a 1-hour exec rehearsal (presentation run-through) on Oct 20 morning

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and venue AV rider for your review — ping me any redlines. If those dates work I will send calendar holds for the full attendee list and start travel hold reservations for our core account team.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Customer Success (APAC)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Alcyon_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (draft), Venue_AV_Rider_SG.xlsx (venue+AV notes)

From: María Ramos <maria.ramos@alcyonhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: scheduling@alcyonhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-03T13:08:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Timezone bridge workshop — initial dates and asks

Hi Vivek,

Thanks — Oct 20–21 looks good for Singapore. We will aim to have two senior execs onsite (CEO Ana Mendes and CTO Suresh Iyer) and the product/infra leads virtual from Tokyo. No blackout dates on our side. We do need an NDA executed before any production data is shared; legal will send our standard template, but we can review Redwood’s redlines.

Attendee notes: Ana is vegetarian (no dairy), Suresh prefers gluten-free. Core onsite headcount: 8 (Ana + 7).

Please send the calendar holds and the AV dry-run invite for Oct 19 afternoon Singapore time. We can use the Zoom bridge you proposed.

Thanks,
María Ramos
Senior Program Manager, Alcyon Health
maría.ramos@alcyonhealth.com

--
Alcyon Health Scheduling: scheduling@alcyonhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Timezone bridge workshop — logistics checklist

Vivek / Lauren — looping in logistics checklist and action items so we can move fast. Summary of next steps:

1) Venue & AV
- Confirm room capacity for 12 (allowing for observers) and hire local AV tech for bridge + mic/room mics. See Venue_AV_Rider_SG.xlsx. Monica to confirm vendor availability by Oct 6.

2) Travel & hotel
- Hold a 6-room block at the adjacent hotel (Hotel_Block_Details.pdf). Lauren to confirm hotel rates and release date (propose release Oct 10).
- Flight holds: conservative routing via SIN with same-day arrivals for internal team — attach placeholder itinerary (Flight_Itinerary_Placeholder.pdf).

3) Rehearsals & agendas
- Schedule AV dry-run Oct 19 15:00 SGT (08:00 BST / 16:00 JST).
- Exec rehearsal Oct 20 09:00 SGT. Lauren to coordinate calendar invites and Zoom bridge (see link).

4) Compliance
- NDA: request legal to triage. Vivek: please forward Redwood’s standard mutual NDA to María and copy legal.

Action owners: Monica = venue/AV vendor, Lauren = hotel + calendars, Vivek = NDA + customer comms. I'll create calendar blocks with tentative times this afternoon and attach venue/options to the deal record.

Monica Patel
Enterprise Events Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Hotel_Block_Details.pdf, Flight_Itinerary_Placeholder.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: María Ramos <maria.ramos@alcyonhealth.com>, scheduling@alcyonhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Timezone bridge workshop — Singapore confirmed (holds + next steps)

Hi María — forwarding our internal plan and calendar holds. Per Monica and Lauren we have:
- Calendar holds: Oct 19 (15:00–16:00 SGT) AV dry-run; Oct 20 (09:00–17:00 SGT) Exec rehearsal + sessions; Oct 21 (09:00–15:00 SGT) Wrap & next steps. I will send invites to the attendee list once NDA is exchanged.
- Attached: final mutual action plan, hotel block details, flight placeholder and AV rider.
- Logistics note: we will run the Zoom bridge from a redundant room to avoid single-point mic failure; Monica will confirm vendor contract.

Please confirm the final onsite attendee list and I will push travel holds for our core account team. Also confirm if you want a separate private follow-up with Ana on Oct 21 afternoon (30 minutes).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success (APAC)
Redwood Inference
